name: write_memory
summary: Cheat: write up to 512 values into a device's memory from start_address, as a chip's put does. Ask the user first. Nothing is written when the range runs past the last address.

help.text: Writes the memory read_memory reads; a Logic Memory has none (memory_not_writable). A range past the memory's last address is invalid_argument and nothing is written. An IC Housing or suit without a chip is no_programmable_chip.

start_address.description: The first address to write, from 0.

values.description: The values, finite numbers, 1 to 512, written from start_address on.
